text_block_list.name: Smartphone Search Bar
text_block_list.text:
"Valentine handmade vs store-bought"
"Valentine handmade turn off"
"Valentine handmade unwanted"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh...
On second thought, let's forget the homemade stuff...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm not good at cooking in the first place...
Store-bought food is definitely way tastier.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...'Valentine's Day popular shops'...
...'Valentine's Day mature sweets'...!?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(There are so many shops here...
Alright, I'll look at the actual items to choose...!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that shop Vivlos likes...
I'm sure you can't go wrong with their luxury chocolates, right?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Wait... is it too heavy?
If it's too expensive, that might be a problem too...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Something easier to eat casually...
Maybe cookies or baked goods would be
easier to snack on between work?)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(No, but would something too casual be...? 
Maybe something more "Valentine-y"...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I want something properly "special."
Not just my usual gratitude, but—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I want to give them delicious chocolates...
that will convey my true feelings!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Still, this place is way too sparkly...
No, but it's for Trainer's sake...!
Do your best...)

text_block_list.name: Clerk A
text_block_list.text:
Welcome~. Looking for something?
Feel free to take a look around if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Ah! I-I-I'm fi—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: U-Um... excuse me...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"C-Can I ask you for some advice...!?
A-About Valentine's Day...!"

text_block_list.name: Clerk A
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'd be delighted to help!
Who will the gift be for?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um... they're someone very, very dear to me...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Always watching over me with kindness... believing in someone like me more than I believe in myself... so sincere, yet a little eccentric...

text_block_list.name: Clerk A
text_block_list.text: Um... what's your relationship with them, and what kind of flavors do they like...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? O-Oh, is that it!?
I-I-I'm so sorry! You're totally right...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Umm... W-Well...!
They're a respected mentor... of mine...!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I-I was able to buy it...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
It'll be fine... right?
This should make them happy, right...?!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Right, a message card too...!
Let's stop by the stationery shop.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And then, on Valentine's Day...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Is it time yet... Is it time yet...
Trai—ner...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Hmm...?

text_block_list.name: Passerby
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hello? My bad, can't make it today~
Yeah, exactly, my girl wants to give me chocolate or whatever~

text_block_list.name: Passerby
text_block_list.text:
You really didn't have to...
Giving something back in return is such a pain. *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh... N-No way...
What should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I never even thought about a return gift...
Would that just make them feel obligated... I wonder?)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Am I... being a nuisance... ?)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(No, that's impossible...!
Trainer isn't the kind of person who'd think that...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah~...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (What should I do? The 14th is almost over...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Still... if I don't know whether they'll be happy with it, maybe it's better not to give it...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right...
You don't need it after all, do you...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
…………
This is just... too much...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—After school, while searching for Cheval Grand,
I spotted her in the track's spectator stands.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Eep!? T-Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Flustered by being suddenly addressed,
she looks adorably flurried as I smile
and hand her the paper bag I've been holding behind my back.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Eeeehhh...?!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: B-Because...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I-I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Why did she apologize...? Just then, I noticed a beautiful box sitting on the bench.
It bore the logo of a famous chocolate shop.
choice_data_list: Oh, did you get some from the others too?
Ah, did you get some from other people too?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!?
Th-Th-That's...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The box of chocolates was open.
More than half of the contents were gone.
They must have been truly delicious.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Th-That's............ Y-Yes, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... um... a lot happened,
and I ended up... stress eating...!
choice_data_list: There are times like that, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, if you'd like...
would you eat the rest...?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I really ate too much, so...
if you could take some, um... I'd be happy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, sitting side by side with Cheval Grand,
I munched on the chocolate.
Looking off into the distance, she quietly murmured.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um... thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll get you something in return...
for White Day...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I'll do it right this time, so...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's not it...!
I didn't get it as a gift...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, my eyes caught a message card
placed beside the box.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...! Ah, ah, uuugh...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
B-But... um... I c-couldn't give it to them...
I thought... maybe it'd just be a bother...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry...
It must be troubling to have something like this dumped on you...
choice_data_list: You have nothing to apologize for.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had a rough idea of what was going on.
Knowing her, she had probably gotten lost in thought again like usual. In that case...
choice_data_list: Of course it's not a bother. I'm really happy!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
R-Really...?
I didn't... make you say that, did I...?
choice_data_list: If it were a bother, I wouldn't have prepared it myself.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's right...
Trainer, you came... to give me chocolate... didn't you...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I... I see...
Um, then... well..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: E-Even now... will you accept it...?
choice_data_list: Of course! Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Yes...! It's nothing special, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I received chocolates from Cheval Grand.
Opening the box revealed an arrangement of simple, mature bitter chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, but it's really delicious chocolate...!
I tasted it myself before choosing, so I guarantee the flavor!"
choice_data_list: You really put your heart into choosing this for me, huh.
You really put your heart into choosing this for me, didn't you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...!
I just wanted to make you happy...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
Trainer, you really are something...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Always watching over me with kindness... believing in someone like me more than I believe in myself... so sincere, yet a little eccentric...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no!
It's nothing... hehe...
